featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a pretty big stationery shop.
They have a vast collection of assorted items which go beyond the scope of just stationery.
It is likely that you will find what you are looking for, or at least a substitute for that, if not that very precise brand.
It is definitely worth a visit.
Was moderately crowded, which was not entirely unexpected.
They provide free parking up to 45 minutes, which is quite useful if you know what you want.
But if you are exploring because of the assorted variety, you are likely to run over that time limit.
All in all, it's a good resourceful place, in my opinion.

featured_reviews.review_text:
On 21st September 2024 we had purchased this 6x6 Rubik's Cube from this damn Anupam stationery. They sweetly did not issue the bill and on trust we took the product. Next day some pieces poped out and when we had gone for replacement they refused to accept as we had no bill. What a scam ? Guys better buy online they never do this. Also offline stores pls don't cry "you don't get business nowadays".  This is what you do to your customers when they trust you Huh.
-–------------------------
The story continues and this time it's positive. Guys got a call from Mr.Sachin Shah floor manager on 25/02/25 (6months later is better late than never :)} Anupam Stationery and he took cognizance of the issue and has give a replacement product. All is well that ends well. I am upgrading the ratings from 1 to 3.5. I am always for offline buying it gives product with a buying experience which online can never give. Once again kudos to Sachin Shah from Anupam Stationery for not ignoring even small issues. Well Done Dear Sachin💐

featured_reviews.review_text: Anupam Stationery is a two-storied, mammoth-sized space filled with a plethora of options for all kinds of stationery and art needs. featured_reviews.review_text: One stop shop for all the stationary items. Located in Borivali West just opposite station. featured_reviews.name: Jyotshna Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an exceptional experience at a supermarket that left me thoroughly impressed. From the moment I walked in, the store was well-organized, with every section clearly marked, making it easy to find all the essentials I needed. I was delighted to see a wide range of groceries, dry fruits, fresh produce, and household items — everything under one roof.

What stood out the most was the affordability of the products without compromising on quality. The prices were reasonable, with some great offers that made the shopping experience even more satisfying.

The staff were incredibly courteous and helpful, always available to guide me in locating items and answering my questions. Their friendly demeanor and quick service at checkout made the experience smooth and enjoyable.

Overall, it was refreshing to shop at a place that offers variety, quality, excellent service, and affordability — a combination that’s hard to find these days. I will definitely be visiting this supermarket again!
